system.description: Sometimes, the only way to prove one's point to the opponent is to teach by example. Only by showing him the harm he has caused so callously can the debater break down her opponent's arguments and win the day. Once an attack connects, the Exalt invokes this Charm to share the pain with her foe. For every level of damage (not every die of damage) the martial artist suffers, her attacker suffers two unsoakable levels of special stunning damage as described by Instruction in Good Will.
system.source: Scroll of the Monk: The Imperfect Lotus
